func run(items: [Int]) async {
 for item in await load() { print(item) }
 for group in items {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  for item in await load(group) { print(item) }
 }
 for item in items {
  func callback() async { await write(item) }
  callbacks.append(callback)
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
  await callback()
  func nested() async {
   for child in children {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    await write(child)
   }
  }
  callbacks.append(nested)
 }
}
